svg.aria-label: Left: Newton's method on e to the x minus 2x replaces the function by its tangent parabola at the current point and jumps to that parabola's minimum. Right: Newton's error falls off a cliff to machine precision in five steps while gradient descent shrinks it by a constant factor per step
